description: Reads a client's need in their own words and suggests the service and the answers it mentions. Rules in code, no language model; check the result with the client.

description.description: The client's need in their own words (optional). Features it mentions, such as integrations, are priced in.

language.description: Language of the texts in the result. Default: en.

name: match_service

answers.description: Answers the description mentions, by question id (q1, q2, q3, when, budget).

title: Match a service to a description
